subject: Oceanography
title: Offshore Oil and Gas
description: Learn Offshore Oil and Gas in one minute.

hook.text: About 30% of the world's oil comes from beneath the ocean floor—drilled from platforms at sea.

buildup.text: Oil and gas form from ancient marine organisms buried under sediment for millions of years.

discovery.text: Heat and pressure cook organic-rich sediment into petroleum—trapped under impermeable cap rocks.

twist.text: Deepwater drilling now reaches 3,000 meters of water plus 10,000 meters into the seafloor.

climax.text: The 2010 Deepwater Horizon disaster spilled 4.9 million barrels—the worst marine oil spill in history.

punchline.text: Ancient sea life became the fuel that drives the modern world.

quiz.question: What percentage of global oil comes from offshore sources?
